electricityContract.terms: For full details on the terms and conditions of our offer check the Terms and Conditions in your Welcome Letter or call Cable Energy on 02 7908 5746
electricityContract.variation: If we are going to vary your Rates, we will provide you with written notice of the variation as soon as practicable  or no later than your next bill or in accordance with any applicable laws and codes.

eligibility.description: Available at eligible supply addresses where Cable Energy can obtain and assess sufficient historical electricity usage data to determine that the customer’s usage profile meets the plan’s eligibility requirements. Supply address must meet Cable Energy’s requirements for the assessment, installation and operation of the Cable Battery System, including technical, metering, network, site and system requirements. Only available to new, and existing customers not within the minimum contract term.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: Contract with us continues on an ongoing basis until you choose to terminate it with us or otherwise switch energy providers.
electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: For information on additional fees, please visit https://www.cable.energy/fees-and-charges or call on 02 7908 5746
